findings_resolved.title: Tolerant-read fail-safe for removed/unknown stepType
findings_resolved.resolution: Added StepType.UNKNOWN sentinel (distinct from removed SEND_MESSAGE/SEND_IMAGE/MENU). New @ReadingConverter StepTypeReadConverter (String -> StepType) maps any unrecognised name to UNKNOWN instead of throwing, registered via new FunnelMongoConfig#mongoCustomConversions (MongoCustomConversions bean — auto-wired by Spring Boot into the application MappingMongoConverter/MongoTemplate). The engine's sweep find(...) now deserialises a legacy document tolerantly; StepExecutor.execute terminal-fails an UNKNOWN step (reason 'unknown_step_type') so just that one execution is isolated, the tick is not aborted. FunnelService.validateSteps also handles UNKNOWN (defensive 422) to keep its exhaustive switch complete.

findings_resolved.title: null/empty-blocks guard in StepExecutor.message()
findings_resolved.resolution: Added a defensive guard at the top of message(): if (blocks == null || blocks.isEmpty()) return StepResult.fail("empty_message_blocks"). Terminal (not a re-loop), consistent with the catch-matrix — a malformed/legacy snapshot self-resolves instead of NPE-looping forever. Happy path unaffected (validateMessage still rejects empty blocks at save).

findings_resolved.title: tolerant-read IT (real Testcontainers Mongo)
findings_resolved.resolution: Added FunnelExecutionEngineIT::legacyRemovedStepType_doesNotCrashSweep_andOtherExecutionsStillProcess. Seeds a valid execution, RAW-mutates its persisted stepsSnapshot.0.stepType to the removed literal "MENU" via mongoTemplate.getCollection("funnel_executions").updateOne($set), seeds a second valid execution, then asserts engine.sweep() does NOT throw, the valid execution completes (sent exactly 1), and the legacy/unknown execution loaded tolerantly and was terminal-failed (status=failed, stepRunStatus=done). Verified it passes in isolation and genuinely exercises the bad-document path.

findings_resolved.title: StepTypeTest negative guard
findings_resolved.resolution: Added StepTypeTest::removedTypesAreAbsent — assertThatThrownBy(StepType.valueOf("SEND_MESSAGE"/"SEND_IMAGE"/"MENU")) is IllegalArgumentException, plus values().extracting(name).doesNotContain(...). Pins the AC that the old constants are gone.

self_review.code_reviewing: OK. Converter is read-path only; author input is rejected at the Jackson DTO boundary (@NotNull StepType), so UNKNOWN can never be authored/saved (confirmed by the full default suite passing — valid StepType round-trips unaffected). Both StepType switches remain exhaustive with no default (compiler-enforced). UNKNOWN is distinct from the removed constants (not re-introduced). MAJ-2 guard is terminal so no stuck/looping row. Logs are id/code-only (no PII); the converter logs the raw discriminator value only (a step-kind, not PII).
self_review.test_master: OK. The tolerant-read IT uses real Testcontainers Mongo and inserts a genuinely RAW removed-value document (not a deserialised stub), asserting both no-throw AND that a sibling valid execution still processes — it actually exercises the failure path (red without the converter: default enum read throws ConversionFailedException and aborts the tick). StepTypeTest negatives pin the AC behaviourally.
